passage: The Covenant defeated the Sworn Men at Meigate in year 49, killing 149 men, and again in year 50, killing 124.
corrected: The Covenant defeated the Sworn Men at Meigate in year 49, killing 149, and again in year 50, killing 124.
note: the record counts 149 dead, not 149 men; the particular is invented. Fixed in round 9 and regressed by round 11.
